sloka: विमुक्तकवचः क्रुद्धः सिक्तः शोणितविस्रवैः ।ततः स पुष्पकं त्यक्त्वा पृथिव्यामवतिष्ठत ।। ७.२१.३९ ॥
transliteration: vimuktakavacaḥ kruddhaḥ siktaḥ śoṇitavisravaiḥ ।tataḥ sa puṣpakaṁ tyaktvā pṛthivyāmavatiṣṭhata ।। 7.21.39 ॥

translations.english: With his armor loosened, enraged, and drenched in streams of blood, he then abandoned the Pushpaka chariot and stood on the earth.
